verdicts.reason: A keeps a legible, well-sized CTA at the right end of a left-to-right banner, but the headline is fairly small, the subcopy is tiny, and the phone is jammed into the gap between the copy and the button with uneven spacing. B gives the headline strong prominence, but its CTA label is shrunk to illegible micro-text inside a tiny pill, and the phone is pushed tight against the left edge, so the action is effectively buried.
